Cloud Billing's billing-account and service/SKU catalog is deliberately not modelled (plan CB5): there is no account lifecycle and no SKU catalog to serve, so a record would be fabricated. The method is an explicit Unimplemented 501 stub naming the Discovery method, so no schema-valid response exists to validate.

The emulator models no billing-account catalog, so billingAccounts.get answers NotFound 404 for every id by design — it never fabricates an account. That is the same answer real GCP gives for an unknown account, and the only shape a real client sees when it lists nothing.

Service Usage operations are long-running mutations with server-assigned ids, and the v1 operations.get path (/v1/operations/{id}) is shared with Cloud Functions v1 on the single origin; the Discovery-driven probe has no operation to stage. The emulator persists and serves the operation (both the v1beta1 poll path and the shared v1 path through the Functions resolver), and the module case asserts the done operation round-trip.
